svg.title: A moving price, a fixed payment schedule
svg.desc: At a required yield of 4%, price is 100. At 5%, price is 92.2783. Price falls 7.72%; the ten coupons remain €4 and principal remains €100.
svg.text: A moving price, a fixed payment schedule
A fictional ten-year bond · €4 annual coupon · €100 principal
The price decline when yield rises from 4% to 5%. Contractual payments
l0g model: annual discounting on a coupon date, using ten coupons and principal. No default or fees. Methodology: [04].
